summary: Correctly replaces string version comparison with packaging.version.Version, resolving the 0.10 < 0.6 bug while keeping a string-comparison fallback for non-PEP440 versions. Uses an existing Sphinx dependency (packaging), so the fix is general and safe to merge.

issues.description: The fulfilled-flag control flow (try/except with nested fallback string compare) is slightly verbose; could be factored into a small helper for readability, but it is clear and correct as written.
No inline comment explaining the InvalidVersion fallback to legacy string comparison; a one-line note would aid future maintainers.
